brief:
Israeli forces shot and killed child Islam al-Ajouri in New Camp military compound east of Nablus, according to medical sources reported by Shehab Wire. The boy was struck by gunfire from occupation forces operating in the refugee camp located in the northern West Bank.

In a separate incident in Gaza Strip, four-year-old Muhammad Abdel Salam Hassan Taha was killed. The child's death came as Israeli military operations continued across the enclave. The killings marked the latest reported deaths of Palestinian children in ongoing military operations across Palestinian territories.
